verdict.rationale: DPMA runs online services (DEPATISnet search, the DPMAregister, and DPMAdirektWeb/DPMAdirektPro e-filing), so API parity with its web interfaces is a fair question. The evidence documents only web interfaces, downloadable filing software and paper/fax routes, with no programmatic API of any kind, let alone one matching the UI. The robots.txt probe concerns crawling, not an API, and adds nothing either way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
